hints.title: Start with courses that have no prerequisites
hints.body: A course can be taken as soon as all courses that must precede it are finished. Track how many unmet prerequisites each course still has.

hints.title: Remove one course at a time
hints.body: Take a course with zero remaining prerequisites, append it to the order, and decrease the count for every course that depends on it. Newly freed courses become available.

hints.title: Choose the smallest available label
hints.body: Several courses may have zero remaining prerequisites. To get the lexicographically smallest order, always take the smallest label among them. A min-heap does this efficiently.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
build graph[prerequisite] -> dependent courses
indegree[course] = number of prerequisites
heap = all courses with indegree 0
order = []

while heap is not empty:
    course = remove smallest from heap
    order.push(course)
    for dependent in graph[course]:
        indegree[dependent] -= 1
        if indegree[dependent] == 0:
            push dependent into heap

if order.length != numCourses: return []
return order
```
